title: The only platform that bridges the digital and the pysical
body: Intelligent lock, connected enclosure, resilient link, and cloud software — one stack that any enclosure can wear, from a climate controlled porch box to a back-of-store cage to a lockbox on a door.

showcases.title: The technology that makes it possible
showcases.body: At the heart of every Veranda-secured recepticle is custom-built hardware doing a lot of work. This modular, LoRaWAN and Bluetooth enabled lock features sensors and firmware to provide an access control system that manages, schedules, and monitors who gets into your box and when.

image.alt: Exploded view of the Veranda smart lock

features.title: Intelligent lock
features.body: Admits the right person automatically, verified against dispatch data. Nothing depends on a code the driver has to type or a key that can be copied.

features.title: Connected enclosure
features.body: The same lock module fits any body: a Veranda porch box, a back-of-store cage or door lockbox; the list goes on. The enclosure changes; the platform doesn't.

features.title: Resilient link
features.body: 433–900 MHz LoRa plus Bluetooth, 1 km reach, no Wi-Fi or cellular dependency. Works at a rural clinic and a downtown loading dock alike.

features.title: Cloud software
features.body: Every open event is logged: who, when, and — where the enclosure carries a sensor — what condition the contents were in. That record is the product for a regulated buyer.

showcases.title: Monitor, schedule, access and control your secured spaces
showcases.body: Stay in control of your deliveries with the Veranda Dashboard. Check the status of your orders, control your Veranda Box, set locking schedules or remotely provide access to authorized individuals. Simply connect all your online merchants and let Veranda handle the rest.

image.alt: Veranda Dashboard app on a phone

features.title: Authentication
features.body: Ensure deliveries reach the right place and people with verified accounts.

features.title: Authorization
features.body: Provide access to exactly the right people, to the right places, at the right times.

features.title: Auditability
features.body: Audit and track the activity of your lock, down to the detail.

features.title: Automation
features.body: Schedule automatic access for regularly planned deliveries.
